REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - OCTOBER 4, 2023 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Community Development Department counter, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development counter during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to planning@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or by using the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to planning@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

Public Comments and Suggestions
This section is reserved for comments related to items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. Comments are limited to 5 minutes per person. Public comments on agenda items will be taken at the time the item is before the Commission.
5.
Approval of the Wednesday, September 6, 2023, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission Regular Meeting Minutes
MINUTES
6.
Public Hearings
6A.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP 84298, A PROPOSAL BY CERRITOS-2 DEVELOPMENT LLC, TO SUBDIVIDE ONE (1) EXISTING PARCEL INTO TWO (2) SEPARATE PARCELS. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS LOCATED AT 13730 ARTESIA BOULEVARD, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703, AND IS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (RS-6500) (APN 7022-005-031).*
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF PRECISE PLAN 2023-15, A PROPOSAL BY CERRITOS-2 DEVELOPMENT LLC, TO CONSTRUCT A NEW SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT COMPRISED OF TWO (2) LOTS, ONE (1) WITH A NEW TWO-STORY RESIDENCE (PARCEL 1), AND ONE (1) WITH A NEW ONE-STORY RESIDENCE AND A DETACHED ACCESSORY DWELLING UNIT (ADU) LOCATED IN THE REAR YARD (PARCEL 2). IN CONJUNCTION WITH THIS PROJECT, A NEW 6'-0" HIGH PERIMETER BLOCK WALL WILL BE CONSTRUCTED ALONG THE NORTH PROPERTY LINE AND THE NEW RESIDENCES WILL BE ACCESSED FROM DRIVEWAYS OFF OF PARKVALLE PLACE. ADDITIONAL IMPROVEMENTS INCLUDE NEW SIDEWALKS, PARKWAY LANDSCAPING, AND OTHER RELATED SITE IMPROVEMENTS. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS LOCATED AT 13730 ARTESIA BOULEVARD, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703, AND IS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (RS-6500) (APN 7022-005-031).*
*The applicant has proposed a detached accessory dwelling unit (ADU) on Parcel 2 of Tentative Parcel Map 84298. In accordance with state planning and zoning laws, and with concurrence by the applicant, the public hearing will not apply to the proposed ADU, which will be processed administratively by City staff after completion of review for the new single-family housing development pursuant to Tentative Parcel Map 84298 and Precise Plan 2023-15.
*Pursuant to Section 15303 and 15315 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

7.
Communications
7A.
Reports from the Department of Community Development
7B.
Reports from Cerritos Planning Commissioners
During this part of the meeting, members of the Commission report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports required by AB 1234. In addition, consensus may be given to refer potential initiatives, policies, programs, or projects to the City Council, for City Council direction on whether to have the Commission review and advise on such initiative, policy, program, or project at a future Commission meeting. Pursuant to the provisions of the California Brown Act, there will be no discussion or action taken on any of the matters that may be presented during this agenda item.
8.
